intro: Trying to find engineering scholarships in Maine usually means narrowing a broad USA search into programs that actually match your location and academic direction. This filtered slice brings together Maine-focused listings tied to engineering and nearby STEM themes, with some overlap into education, architecture, construction trades, and technology education. The rows below are worth a close look because award amounts, eligibility details, and deadline timing can differ from one listing to the next, and many appear to have comparatively lighter application requirements. Several listings also look like they may not require an essay, though you should still verify each official page before you apply. If you want to compare options quickly for the current cycle, this is a practical place to start.
